title: Instagram Made Indians Believe This
description:
Every day Indian Instagram is flooded with reels claiming that ancient India invented airplanes, WiFi, quantum physics, nuclear weapons, stem cell technology and almost every modern scientific discovery imaginable. But why are these videos becoming so popular? Why do even educated people believe them? And why does fake historical pride spread faster online than actual science?

In this video we break down the rise of “Instagram mythology”, fake Vedic science claims, WhatsApp University style misinformation, algorithm-driven nationalism, pseudoscience, fake patriotism and the growing obsession with proving that ancient India already discovered everything.

From Vaimanika Shastra claims to quantum physics in the Vedas, from fake NASA quotes to AI-generated godmen reels, this video explores how social media rewards confidence over evidence and emotion over scientific thinking.

We also discuss:
• Ancient India achievements

If you’ve searched for ancient India science claims, Vedic science debunked, fake Indian history reels, pseudoscience in India, Instagram misinformation, WhatsApp University, rationalist videos, scientific temper India, this video gives you the rational perspective.
